text:
deploy-bot: [deploy-start] tagged release v1.6.5-hotfix -> prod-norcal (canary). commit=7f3a2b9. initiated by @maya. change-window=immediate. ETA canary=5m :rocket:
maya: heads-up — hotfix for tokenizer crash in long-contexts. should be low-risk but patch touches kv-cache code path.
liam: noted. commit 7f3a2b9 includes the backport from PR #1284. verified unit + integration tests passed on staging.
sre-oncall: starting canary monitor. I'll post metrics. keeping an eye on p90 and error-rate.
carol: @maya can we pin traffic to 2% for canary and ramp to 20 after 10m if green?
maya: yes 2% -> 20% after 10m sounds good. also add fallback to v1.6.4 if error-rate > 1% or p95 increases >100ms.
deploy-bot: canary deployed to subset prod-norcal-1 (hosts: norcal-005, norcal-012). status=ok.
sre-oncall: initial metrics @ +2m: p90 latency +8ms, errors 0.18% (baseline 0.12%). CPU on norcal-012 spiked 6% but fine. logs show one kv-cache WARN but no crashing traces.
axel: can we run the smoke job again? `./scripts/smoke.sh --region norcal --tag v1.6.5-hotfix`
liam: smoke runs ok locally, pushing remote now.
sre-oncall: smoke job output:
```
ok: 120/120 requests successful
max_latency_ms: 210
avg_latency_ms: 48
errors: 0
```
maya: thanks. leaning to promote at +10m. leaving a 2-minute buffer to watch for regression.
deploy-bot: scheduled ramp: 2% -> 20% at 1976543810 (in 10m).
carol: small ask — include release note snippet in changelog: "fix: tokenizer long-context memory leak (backport)" and tag on release page.
maya: done, added changelog entry and notify customers with the support note.
sre-oncall: at +9m seeing one 503 from norcal-012, investigating stack traces.
liam: stack trace shows `kv_cache::get_or_refresh` null deref in rare branch. that's concerning.
axel: do we have quick revert? we can pin traffic back to v1.6.4 via router toggle.
maya: pause ramp. rollback plan: pin to v1.6.4 in prod-norcal, then promote v1.6.5 to staging for debug.
deploy-bot: action=pin_version region=prod-norcal pinned_to=v1.6.4 by=@maya. status=complete.
sre-oncall: pin successful. error-rate dropped back to baseline and 503s stopped.
carol: good call. create follow-up issue to revert the backport until the null check is added. assign to @liam.
liam: will open issue and push small fix + test. apologies — will run targeted fuzzing next. :pray:
maya: thanks team. rolling back was clean. will reschedule hotfix after patch merge and extra tests.
axel: +1 on reschedule — prefer canary on eu region too next time.
deploy-bot: [deploy-finish] tagged release v1.6.5-hotfix -> prod-norcal (canary) ended with pin to v1.6.4. thread closed.
